locations.name: Battlefield is slowly sinking into pudding
locations.desc: The ground is a wobbly, sweet landscape, slowly but surely pulling everyone down into a sticky, purple abyss.

locations.name: Entire arena rotates like a giant lazy Susan
locations.desc: The circular platform spins lazily, forcing fighters to constantly adjust to the shifting centrifugal force.

locations.name: Fight takes place on a giant trampoline field
locations.desc: Every step is a spring, turning combat into a dizzying ballet of high-flying bounces and unpredictable landings.

locations.name: Arena is a giant library where silence is enforced
locations.desc: A hushed battleground lined with towering shelves. Any loud action or cry earns a brutal, instant penalty from the omnipresent Librarian.

locations.name: Everything is covered in banana peels
locations.desc: A treacherous, yellow-slicked floor where every movement is a risk, and even the walls offer no grip.

locations.name: Fight happens on top of speeding hover buses
locations.desc: The battle unfolds across the precarious roofs of several high-speed, driverless buses zipping through a futuristic city.

locations.name: Arena is a maze that reconfigures every minute
locations.desc: Just when you think you have your opponent cornered, the walls slide and shift, creating an entirely new, confusing layout.

locations.name: Location is a massive bouncy castle
locations.desc: Soft, inflated walls and floor make footing impossible, turning every attack into a goofy, airborne fumble.

locations.name: Battlefield is floating platforms that fall apart
locations.desc: A series of stone or metal pads hover over a deadly chasm, crumbling away piece by piece with every forceful impact.

locations.name: Arena is a chaotic food court during lunch rush
locations.desc: The fight rages amidst angry customers, spilled trays, and the sudden, dangerous appearance of greasy, flung food items.

locations.name: Fight on a giant vinyl record spinning slowly
locations.desc: The enormous black disc rotates at a steady pace, forcing fighters to chase or avoid the center, while a massive, dusty needle hangs overhead.

locations.name: Arena is pitch-black except for glow sticks
locations.desc: Only the intermittent glow of dropped or worn glow sticks illuminates the dark, making surprise attacks inevitable.

locations.name: Battle on a huge conveyor belt moving fast
locations.desc: Fighters must constantly sprint just to stay in the game, turning the match into an exhausting, high-velocity struggle.

locations.name: Arena is a giant ball pit of endless depth
locations.desc: Jumping and movement are stifled by a vast sea of plastic spheres, hiding hazards and making any quick escape a nightmare.

locations.name: Fight takes place inside a kid’s science museum
locations.desc: The battlefield is cluttered with interactive, but highly dangerous, exhibits like static electricity balls and mock tornado tubes.

locations.name: Arena is a frozen lake covered in wet soap
locations.desc: It's an incredibly slick, glassy surface where sliding is the only real form of movement, and stopping is nearly impossible.

locations.name: Battle in a stadium where gravity changes randomly
locations.desc: At the sound of a klaxon, gravity can become heavy, light, or even reverse, sending fighters flying or slamming them to the ground.

locations.name: Arena is a massive corn maze
locations.desc: Tall, rustling stalks obscure vision, turning the fight into a terrifying game of hide-and-seek where you never know what's around the next corner.

locations.name: Fight on a train made entirely of cardboard
locations.desc: The entire structure is fragile and easily ripped or punched through, forcing fighters to avoid destroying their own arena.

locations.name: Arena is a theme park ride stuck on loop
locations.desc: The battle rages on a constantly jerking, looping track that goes up, down, and upside down, making movement a dizzying challenge.

locations.name: Fight happens in a mall during Black Friday
locations.desc: The real enemies are the swarming, bargain-hungry crowds and the stray shopping carts that slam into the fighters.

locations.name: Arena is a giant trampoline funhouse
locations.desc: A confusing, multi-level structure made entirely of netting and trampolines, guaranteeing a constantly bouncing, disorienting experience.

locations.name: Battle on a floating island with unstable edges
locations.desc: The small patch of land drifts over a massive drop, with its brittle, cracked perimeter crumbling under every landing.

locations.name: Arena is a children’s birthday party gone wrong
locations.desc: The battlefield is scattered with exploded balloons, sticky cake, and the menacing, broken remnants of a pinata.

locations.name: Fight inside a giant hamster habitat
locations.desc: Fighters navigate oversized tubes, a massive running wheel, and a mountain of wood shavings, all while being observed by a curious, monolithic 'owner'.

locations.name: Arena is a spooky carnival at 3 a.m.
locations.desc: Creepy, abandoned rides and flickering, broken lights provide a terrifying atmosphere, with unsettling clowns lurking just out of sight.

locations.name: Fight in a room where everything is inflatable
locations.desc: Walls, obstacles, and furniture all bounce and buckle under pressure, turning the environment into a squeaky, temporary mess.

locations.name: Arena is a pirate ship during a storm
locations.desc: The deck pitches violently, slick with rain, as lightning flashes and waves crash over the sides, threatening to sweep fighters away.

locations.name: Fight inside a giant aquarium tunnel
locations.desc: The battle takes place within a curved glass corridor deep underwater, with massive, dangerous marine life pressing against the walls.

locations.name: Arena is a reality TV show set
locations.desc: The fight is constantly interrupted by dramatic cuts, sound effects, and the sudden, intrusive demands of an unseen Director.

locations.name: Fight inside a chaotic high school hallway
locations.desc: Fighters must dodge opening lockers, slip on spilled cafeteria food, and avoid the angry, surging tides of class-changing teenagers.

locations.name: Arena is a lava lamp factory
locations.desc: The battlefield is slick with leaking, hot wax and surrounded by vats of swirling, brightly colored, volatile liquid.

locations.name: Fight on a giant chessboard with moving pieces
locations.desc: The black and white tiles are the stage for combat, but every few moments, massive, stone chess pieces suddenly move, crushing anyone in their path.

locations.name: Arena is a scrapyard with magnet cranes
locations.desc: Massive magnets swing overhead, randomly attracting metal weapons and pulling fighters into dangerous piles of jagged scrap.

locations.name: Battle in a giant greenhouse filled with dangerous plants
locations.desc: Fighters must contend with snapping flytraps, acid-spitting flowers, and suffocating vines in a humid, overgrown arena.

locations.name: Arena is an airport during massive delays
locations.desc: The battle rages through angry, stressed crowds, amidst luggage carousels, and with the constant, irritating sound of gate announcements.

locations.name: Fight on a massive floating lily pad field
locations.desc: The only solid ground is a series of large, wobbly plant pads, separated by dark water that hides unknown dangers.

locations.name: Arena is a snow globe being shaken constantly
locations.desc: The entire world is a small glass sphere, and a giant unseen hand keeps violently shaking it, causing constant turbulence and a blizzard.

locations.name: Battle inside a giant claw machine
locations.desc: The arena is a pit of plush toys, and a slow, metal claw periodically descends, trying to grab and eliminate the fighters.

locations.name: Arena is an unstable suspension bridge
locations.desc: High above a dangerous canyon, the narrow bridge sways and bounces unpredictably with every step and explosion.

locations.name: Fight on a wild roller rink
locations.desc: Everyone is on roller skates, making combat a mix of graceful glides, uncontrolled slides, and spectacular, painful tumbles.

locations.name: Arena is an active movie set with explosions
locations.desc: The fight is constantly interrupted by pyrotechnics, collapsing facades, and the frantic shouts of crew members.

locations.name: Battle in a giant kitchen where everything is alive
locations.desc: Sentient, aggressive appliances, walking vegetables, and a very angry, boiling pot of soup are all environmental hazards.

locations.name: Arena is a rooftop during a fireworks festival
locations.desc: The fight takes place high above a city, with brilliant but distracting and sometimes explosive fireworks erupting all around.

locations.name: Fight on a giant Rubik’s cube rotating randomly
locations.desc: The massive, colorful surface constantly shifts, changing the path, elevation, and available footing for all fighters.

locations.name: Arena is a forest of giant wobbling mushrooms
locations.desc: The ground is springy, and colossal fungi bounce and sway, making it easy to lose balance and vision.

locations.name: Battle in an unfinished skyscraper with no walls
locations.desc: The fight rages on skeletal metal floors high in the air, with nothing but open sky and a long drop on all sides.

locations.name: Fight inside a malfunctioning VR simulation
locations.desc: The environment flickers, textures randomly disappear, and gravity frequently glitches out, creating a surreal and unpredictable battle.
